pages.title: Supply Request
pages.text: $(bold)REPLACEMENT REQUISITION$()$(br)Filed by: Civilian station staff$(br2)Requested items: thermocouple assemblies, anemometer bearings, insulated cable, generator belts.$(br2)Reason: equipment operating outside rated limits after the June 20 orbital event.

pages.title: Disposition
pages.text: Stamped three times: $(italic)PENDING$(), $(italic)DEFERRED$(), $(italic)NO ROUTE AVAILABLE$().$(br2)ORSA bolted its terminal into the station, demanded clean data, then stopped resupplying the people taking the readings.$(br2)The weather mattered. The meteorologists apparently did not.
